releaseNotes: 3.3.2 - fix: the app no longer assumes CSC. On login and at every start it asks GET /api/app/context which site this domain and login belong to, stores that site, and every list (suppliers, items, counts) follows it - so SiteName Shanta shows Shanta's suppliers (Food Bank etc.), and any other site shows its own. Site picker on Add Item defaults to the resolved site.
